recommended_action: Route T032 to the planning lane (Planner -> independent Plan Reviewer), paralleling the T030 / T031 path. Planner must merge the 2026-09-16 Owner amendment into a single unified T032 contract body by updating the Outcome / Deliverables / Acceptance / Must-not / References sections of todo/phases/P03-ingestion-and-storage/T032.md, remove the separate `FROZEN_FROM_BASELINE_6C31778` marker plus the top amendment block, and inline Owner Decision 4 and Decision 5 verbatim where they change contract text: (a) explicit T032 scope = capability-driven historical ingestion with A+B routing; (b) preflight probe persists per-endpoint capabilities and a call/CU/time budget, and retains the remaining-budget bound from operator injection or provider usage API rather than assuming unused monthly quota; (c) one pool-filtered topic0 OR query covers Initialize / ModifyLiquidity / Swap / Donate plus inherited ProtocolFeeUpdated, with topic1 fixed to the selected PoolKey's poolId; (d) Robinhood public RPC is the initial wide-range log source and sends an explicit non-secret application User-Agent; Alchemy Free supplies archive/block-pinned reads and sampled verification; (e) either endpoint may fail over only within its measured capability and remaining budget, with provenance recorded per successful or failed interval and no silent merging of partial responses; (f) cold start scans from the selected pool's registered Initialize block through the requested end block and a shorter backtest start does not truncate the reconstruction prefix; warm runs may take suffix-only ingestion only when a previously qualified local checkpoint exists; (g) fetch one non-hydrated block header per distinct event block and reuse it across events; do not download hydrated blocks, all transactions, or all receipts as part of ordinary pool-history ingestion; (h) Acceptance must enumerate the scanned_empty / failed / cancelled/skipped boundary with explicit reason codes for budget exhaustion, the requirement that a checkpoint never advances past a failed / uncovered interval, and fixtures covering Alchemy's observed 10-block limit, Robinhood wide-range success followed by adaptive split, HTTP 403 from a missing/blocked User-Agent, response-size overflow, rate limiting, budget exhaustion with complete=false, and provider failover without gaps; (i) Must-not keeps the existing prohibitions (no advance checkpoint before durable commit, no inferred empty coverage from an empty table, no completion past an irreducible failed block, no one scan per event type when a combined filter suffices, no describing HTTP batches as fewer RPC calls) and adds prohibitions on advanced split / range / response-size / timeout / throttling / single-block overflow adaptive split being silently skipped, on assuming a 10,000-block provider cap, and on any 'local-skip-then-complete' path; (j) References keeps R9, R11, R23, R24, R25, ADR-010, ADR-011 and add Implementation status / binding-direction reference subsection that cites /tmp/owner_decision_T032.txt as the binding source without reopening ADR-002 or ADR-010. Do not bypass planning by editing the contract from the Developer lane. Independent Plan Reviewer must confirm completeness, consistency, and that acceptance was not weakened before the next Developer attempt; plan review only approves contract executability, not implementation, and does not change T032 implementation status.
